moods.mood_description: Intense competition for power and internal conflicts
Fundamental conflict between different political ideologies
Change in public opinion or the beginning of a mass movement
Political maneuvers, alliance formation, or strategic steps
Exposure of political corruption or disclosure of scandal
Intense debate and arguments for and against on important policy matters
Opposition, protest, and public outrage against the government
Tension in international relations or diplomatic crisis
Challenge to current leadership or prediction of power change
Heat of election campaigns and uncertainty about the future
